Fortress · 40 min

The sea fortress built by Venice to guard Crete.

▶ Play audio guide
The story

Venice ruled Crete for over 400 years and called the island Candia. The fortress at the harbor mouth, Koules, was built in the 1520s. Look for the stone lion of Saint Mark, the symbol of Venice, carved on its walls. During the Ottoman siege of 1648 to 1669, the city held out for 21 years, one of the longest sieges in history. Inside are vaulted halls where ships' supplies were stored, and from the roof you see the whole harbor and the arched Venetian shipyards along the waterfront.

WHAT TO LOOK FOR
The winged lion of Saint Mark on the walls.
The arched Venetian arsenals along the harbor.
The view back to the town and mountains from the roof.

Fortress · 40 min

The sea fortress built by Venice to guard Crete.

▶ Play audio guide
The story

Venice ruled Crete for over 400 years and called the island Candia. The fortress at the harbor mouth, Koules, was built in the 1520s. Look for the stone lion of Saint Mark, the symbol of Venice, carved on its walls. During the Ottoman siege of 1648 to 1669, the city held out for 21 years, one of the longest sieges in history. Inside are vaulted halls where ships' supplies were stored, and from the roof you see the whole harbor and the arched Venetian shipyards along the waterfront.

WHAT TO LOOK FOR
The winged lion of Saint Mark on the walls.
The arched Venetian arsenals along the harbor.
The view back to the town and mountains from the roof.
